acme-cs: Hey team — our prod inference jobs started failing around 2026-03-17T11:45Z. We see repeated 502s and timeouts. Example request IDs: req_9f3a2c7a, req_9f3a2d00. High tail latency too. Can you help collect repro logs? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria (Support): Thanks — we can help gather. Can you run a curl that reproduces the failure (no API keys in public)? Paste the full curl output + any x-redwood-request-id header you see. Example below.

acme-cs: Thanks, trying now. Will paste output in a sec.

maria (Support): Example reproducible curl (replace HOST/KEY/JSON):

```bash
curl -i -v \"https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate\" \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDFW_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-medium","input":"Summarize the following..."}'
```

maria (Support): After that please run these quick collects and paste the outputs or upload the bundle: short list below.
1) kubectl logs -n tenant-zeta inference-5f7c9d8d-2q4x --tail=500
2) kubectl describe pod -n tenant-zeta inference-5f7c9d8d-2q4x
3) journalctl -u kubelet --since "1 hour ago" | tail -n 200
4) sudo dmesg | tail -n 200
5) nvidia-smi --query-gpu=timestamp,name,utilization.gpu,temperature.gpu,memory.used --format=csv

jonathan (SRE): Got it. I'll pull pod logs from our side as well and check Prometheus for latency spikes. @kevin (Infra) can you run dmesg + nvidia-smi on node gpu-node-07 where inference-5f7c9d8d-2q4x was scheduled? Suspect a GPU memory thrash or intermittent XID.

kevin (Infra): On it. If you can, run this to collect everything into a bundle on the node:

```bash
set -e
BUNDLE_DIR=/tmp/tenant-zeta-debug-1773701234
mkdir -p $BUNDLE_DIR
kubectl -n tenant-zeta logs inference-5f7c9d8d-2q4x --tail=2000 > $BUNDLE_DIR/pod-logs.txt || true
kubectl -n tenant-zeta describe pod inference-5f7c9d8d-2q4x > $BUNDLE_DIR/pod-describe.txt || true
journalctl -u kubelet --since "2 hours ago" > $BUNDLE_DIR/kubelet-journal.txt || true
sudo dmesg | tail -n 500 > $BUNDLE_DIR/dmesg-tail.txt || true
/usr/bin/nvidia-smi --query-gpu=timestamp,name,utilization.gpu,temperature.gpu,memory.used --format=csv > $BUNDLE_DIR/nvidia-smi.csv || true
# collect process list on node
ps auxf > $BUNDLE_DIR/ps-aux.txt || true
# compress
tar -czf /tmp/tenant-zeta-debug-1773701234.tar.gz -C /tmp tenant-zeta-debug-1773701234
# upload (example)
# aws s3 cp /tmp/tenant-zeta-debug-1773701234.tar.gz s3://redwood-support/tenant-zeta/ || true
```

acme-cs: Pod is inference-5f7c9d8d-2q4x on node gpu-node-07. Request body of failing call: {"input":"Summarize long doc...","max_tokens":2048}. Header returned x-redwood-request-id: req_9f3a2c7a. Posting curl output now: HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
<...> x-redwood-request-id: req_9f3a2c7a

jonathan (SRE): Thanks. I'm querying Prometheus for 95p/99p for that pod and timeframe. Query I'm running:

```
rate(redwood_inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket{pod=~"inference-5f7c.*"}[5m])
```

jonathan (SRE): Also checking if any autoscaler events or OOMKills during the window.

kevin (Infra): Pulled dmesg and nvidia-smi. No XID entries in last 500 lines, but GPU memory used shot to ~13200 MiB at 11:44:22Z repeatedly. Saved bundle to s3://redwood-support/tenant-zeta/1773701234-debug.tar.gz (private).

maria (Support): Perfect — please paste the signed S3 link or upload via our support uploader: https://support-upload.redwood.ai/ (you can drop the tarball there). Once we have the curl output, the pod logs, dmesg, and nvidia-smi snapshot we'll triage.

maria (Support): Quick checklist for customer to run if they can: remove custom quantization flags, try model with smaller max_tokens, and attempt same request against a small test model to see if it reproduces.

acme-cs: Uploading bundle now. URL: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-support/tenant-zeta/1773701234-debug.tar.gz (valid for 24h).

jonathan (SRE): I've attached a small graph from Prometheus showing 99p latency spike at 11:44—looks correlated with batch size jump. Forwarding to eng-runtime with logs.

kevin (Infra): Also captured pod env: REDWOOD_MODEL=gpt-medium, QUANTIZE=on, BATCHER=max-pool-32. Noting QUANTIZE=on + batch surge might be reproducer.

maria (Support): Thanks everyone. We'll open an eng-runtime ticket to investigate quantize path + large batches. Please add any missing pieces to the bundle and ping this thread. :raised_hands:

sre-bot: Support ticket #T-82344 created and assigned to eng-runtime. SLA: 4h.
